# ms: # Qwen Code 0.23.0 starting in a Sidecar-managed shell on a private tmux server.
# One row is the whole integration: upstream's table has one event and this port
# keeps it, so the trace that earns the tier is the trace that shows that event
# firing from a released build and carrying a session id.
# THE EVENT FIRES BEFORE AUTHENTICATION, and that is the finding that made this
# tier reachable at all. The pane was sitting on Qwen's "Connect a Provider"
# picker with no auth type selected and no credentials configured for it; the
# hook had already run and Sidecar had already bound the pane. A model turn is
# not needed to prove session identity for this provider, which is worth knowing
# for every future requalification: a capture costs one process start.
# The same payload arrives under `qwen -p`, where the run then refuses with "No
# auth type is selected" -- so the event belongs to session creation rather than
# to the interactive UI.
# `source` carries a value because it is SessionStart's own discriminator and
# Qwen's hooks reference closes its vocabulary at startup, resume, clear and
# compact. Every other field is a bare name: `transcript_path` and `cwd` are
# paths, `session_id` is an identifier, and none of them may be recorded here.
# What this capture does NOT establish: `qwen --resume <id>` on the id above
# produced no second SessionStart in roughly 25 seconds of watching, but the
# resume's own success was never established, so that is an unexplained
# observation rather than an absence. The "*" matcher is therefore proved to
# catch source=startup and nothing more.
